sections.h2: Only 19% of approved PLI outlay has been paid, with several schemes at zero

chart.title: Only PLI Pharmaceuticals has paid more than a tenth of its outlay; three schemes show zero
chart.sub: Share of scheme outlay paid out, %.
chart.source: Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha answers; Ministry of Heavy Industries; PIB.

sections.means: Disbursement has climbed from ₹23,946 crore in September 2025 to ₹36,754 crore by June 2026, but the share paid is still low.
sections.todo: Check the date on any PLI payout figure before quoting it, because these totals move every quarter.

sections.h2: The subsidy for new silicon fabs fell from 50% to 40% under ISM 2.0

chart.title: Micron's 50% rate is now historic; new silicon fabs get 40%
chart.sub: Central fiscal support as a share of project cost, %.
chart.source: ISM 2.0 budget announcement; BusinessToday; Policy Circle.
rows: Compound or display fab, advanced packaging

sections.means: Under ISM 2.0 the central fiscal-support rate for new silicon fabs has fallen from the 50% Micron received to 40%.
sections.todo: Use the 40% rate, not the old 50%, when quoting India's semiconductor subsidy.

sections.h2: The four PLI battery-cell beneficiaries are all domestic, and none has claimed incentive

chart.title: Ola leads the four cell-makers at 20 GWh; none has yet drawn incentive
chart.source: Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha answers; Ministry of Heavy Industries.

sections.means: The scheme's four approved cell-makers are all domestic, and the widely repeated $1.5 billion LG Energy Solution–JSW venture appears nowhere in government records.
sections.todo: Watch for quarterly payouts from Ola and Reliance, and treat any foreign cell-maker headline as unconfirmed until it appears in a government record.

sections.h2: Medical devices is the one PLI scheme where investment has run ahead of commitment

chart.title: Actual investment of ₹1,153.07 crore slightly exceeds the ₹1,136.23 crore committed
chart.sub: PLI Medical Devices, 27 approved projects, ₹ crore.
chart.source: Department of Pharmaceuticals statements; Indian Pharma Post; Lokmat Times.

sections.means: Of 27 approved projects, 23 are commissioned and actual investment is slightly above what was committed.
sections.todo: Treat PLI Medical Devices as the benchmark for execution when judging the other schemes.
